label: class_e_05_battle_01
text: Another day, another round of battle study! Osu!\nLet’s get right to it![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_02
text: You all gave everything you had on the midterm\nexams. Well done![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_03
text: We’ll resume our regular classes today, so keep\nup that energy for the second half of the term![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_04
text: Have you all been using the R Button to send out\nyour Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_05
text: If you do, your Pokémon will run off in the\ndirection you’re facing.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_06
text: It’s a super-useful tactic that lets your Pokémon\npick up faraway items for you. And that’s not all![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_07
text: If there’s a wild Pokémon near where you sent\nyour Pokémon, they’ll start battling each other![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_08
text: We call those battles...Auto Battles![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_09
text: Just as the name implies, your Pokémon will\nact on its own during Auto Battles—meaning\r\nyou won’t have to give it any commands![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_10
text: And if your Pokémon wins, it’ll get Exp. Points\njust like it would in a regular battle.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_11
text: If you make good use of these battles, they can\nbe a really efficient way to train your party![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_12
text: But you’ll want to remember that Pokémon won’t\nevolve or learn new moves right away if they level\r\nup from an Auto Battle.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_13
text: Also, if a Pokémon LOSES an Auto Battle, it’ll\ncome back with just a small amount of HP left.\r\nMake sure to heal it up right away![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_14
text: Whoops. I just about did the whole class as a\none-sided lecture. Does anyone have any\r\nquestions so far?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_select_01
text: How do I stop an Auto Battle?

label: class_e_05_select_02
text: Can I catch wild Pokémon in Auto Battles?

label: class_e_05_select_03
text: No questions here!

label: class_e_05_battle_answer_01
text:
There’s no stopping an Auto Battle once it starts!
You’ll have to wait and see how it plays out!\c
You can call your Pokémon off before the battle
starts, though, if you press the ZR Button while
your Pokémon is still on its way to the opponent![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_answer_02
text:
If you let your Pokémon battle on its own, it’ll
keep going until its opponent is defeated!\c
If you want to catch a wild Pokémon, you’ll need
to battle by issuing commands instead![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_answer_03
text: Great! You’re all really good at this. I can’t wait\nto see where you go from here![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_15
text: Even during Auto Battles, our Pokémon are out\nthere battling for us—their Trainers![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_16
text: Keep an eye on them as much as possible, and\nif it looks like they’re going to lose, be sure to\r\nhave them retreat![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_17
text: Also, this goes without saying, but Pokémon with\nlow HP are already worn out.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_18
text: They probably won’t enjoy Auto Battles as much,\nso don’t work them too hard, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_19
text: In conclusion![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_20
text: Auto Battles only work if a Trainer and their\nPokémon have a relationship of mutual trust![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_21
text: Be smart with how you use Auto Battles so you\ndon’t lose the trust of your Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_22
text: Aw, man! I was just about to suggest we do some\nhands-on practice to really drive the point home,\r\nbut I guess we’ve run out of time, as usual...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_05_battle_23
text: Class is over for now! Take care, you little rascals![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
